name: PNC Bank
notes: Researched from public pnc.com pages only (no sign-in). The mock bill is a PNC auto loan. Online Banking/app: select the loan and choose Make a Payment for one-time, same-day or recurring payments from a PNC or external account. The Automated Payment Program (autopay) is enrolled by form or by phone (1-888-762-2265), takes up to 10 business days, can be suspended for one month or cancelled by calling at least 3 business days before the due date; cancelling removes any autopay rate discount. Online recurring payments exist, so autopay stays supported online (the form-only program is described in help). Phone payments by 6 p.m. ET credit same day and cannot be cancelled. Mail: PNC Bank, PO Box 747066, Pittsburgh, PA 15274-7066 (allow 7-10 days). Payoff quote under Account Actions > View Loan Payoff Quote. Sign-on: User ID + password; optional texted one-time passcode valid 10 minutes. No guest pay (inferred). Reviewed 2026-10-09: 10-business-day processing and confirmation letter verified in the Automated Payment Authorization Form PDF (added as source); hardship label matches the page.

guest_pay.note: PNC auto loans are paid in Online Banking or the app after signing on, by phone at 1-888-PNC-BANK (1-888-762-2265), by mail or at a branch.

help.title: Make an auto loan payment
paragraphs: In the PNC Mobile app or Online Banking, select your loan account and choose Make a Payment. You can schedule a one-time, same-day or recurring payment from a PNC account or an external account (have its routing and account numbers ready).
By phone, call 1-888-PNC-BANK (1-888-762-2265). Payments made by 6:00 p.m. ET are credited the same day and cannot be cancelled once submitted.

By mail, send your payment slip and check to PNC Bank, PO Box 747066, Pittsburgh, PA 15274-7066 and allow 7-10 days. Branch payments are effective the same day but can take up to 2 business days to appear.

help.title: Automated Payment Program
paragraphs: The Automated Payment Program deducts your monthly payment from your bank account. Return the Automated Payment Authorization form by mail, fax or at a branch, or call 1-888-762-2265 to have it emailed. Processing can take up to 10 business days after PNC receives the form; keep paying until the confirmation letter with your start date arrives. Once confirmed, monthly paper statements stop and the statement is in Online Banking.

You can suspend automatic payment for one month (you must then pay manually) or cancel it by calling at least 3 business days before your next due date. Cancelling removes any autopay interest rate discount, which can raise your payment.
You can also schedule recurring payments yourself in Online Banking with Make a Payment.

help.title: Get a payoff quote
paragraphs: Sign on to Online Banking, select your loan and choose View Loan Payoff Quote under Account Actions. If it is not shown, call 1-888-762-2265.

help.title: Added sign-on security
paragraphs: After your User ID and password, PNC can text a one-time passcode to your phone. Turn it on under Customer Service, Security Settings, Two-Step Verification. A new code is sent every sign-on and expires once used or after 10 minutes; choose Request New Code if it does not arrive.

help.title: Contact PNC auto lending
paragraphs: Call 1-888-PNC-BANK (1-888-762-2265): automated service 24/7; consultants Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. ET and weekends 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET. For hardship help, use PNC Lending Hardship Service & Support.
